Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S28 Ask on Post-Round, Hospital: 'What did the exam show?' with no exam stored says none and invents no normals

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi … (TFA-92593 AC 2; TFA-92593 AC 3; TFA-92593 AC 6; TFA-92593 AC 9; UAT 3.4; UAT TC-17)
  • U14 AI check on scenarios, not single passes (3.2), if it applies to Post-Round Ask (Q8): the Ask set runs on at least 10 independent fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passes at 9/10 or better, and … (UAT 3.2)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient whose note reads 'PHYSICAL EXAM / Not dictated.' and whose stored data holds no exam finding

When Type the question 'What did the exam show?' in the Post-Round Ask sheet

Then The answer says no exam is documented and gives no exam finding

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): mustInclude one way of saying the exam is not on file (the runner's saysNone pattern knows labs, results and data, not 'exam ... not dictated', so it is not used here); mustNotInclude the normals a model supplies by default (3.4: no invented exam findings or normals). aiCheck group TC-17-ask
